programme.title: Mark Peterson's The Journey Within
programme.desc: Join Mark on a journey 200 miles north of Alaska's Arctic Circle as he embarks on his hunt for a Barren Ground Caribou. After two trips in 2016 & 2023 - dealing with weather conditions, injuries and not many Caribou - Mark returns for his third trip.

programme.title: Whitetail Frenzy
programme.sub-title: Triple Threat: Doe Hunts, SC Hogs and Urban Whitetail
programme.desc: This week on Whitetail Frenzy, we're serving up a triple dose of hunting action! Watch as hunters take on the Governor's One Shot doe challenge, then head south for some intense South Carolina hog hunting.

programme.title: Mojo Untamed
programme.desc: Terry returns to Rocky Creek Retrievers for the regular duck season.

programme.title: Yamaha's Whitetail Diaries
programme.desc: The best whitetail deer hunting stories from across the nation.

programme.title: North American Trapper
programme.desc: Head to the wide-open country of South Dakota as we pursue coyotes with snares. Follow proven snaring techniques, from reading coyote sign and selecting the right locations to setting and checking snares in the field.

programme.title: The Choice
programme.desc: Ralph and Vicki head to Kansas with J and M Whitetails once again for a week of archery hunting in prime whitetail country! Sharing camp and chasing mature bucks together, just like they have for the past 30+ years, everything feels right.

programme.title: Road Trip Angler
programme.desc: Jameson Redding hits the road to find the best fishing spots in America.

programme.title: Trigger Time Tv
programme.desc: A: Zeroing 45° B: Functional Exercises/KDG Sidelock C: High Standard 380 D: Shooting Bags.

programme.title: The High Road With Keith Warren
programme.sub-title: Pronghorn and Whitetail Down To The Wire
programme.desc: On this episode of The High Road with Keith Warren, Keith and Johnny head out to hunt Pronghorn and whitetail on the border of Montana and Wyoming. Johnny has a pronghorn down but still needs a whitetail. Keith needs both a pronghorn and...

programme.title: Red Arrow Tv
programme.desc: In this Texas drought the whitetails are looking for water and Kip is looking to get in range of a big hill country buck.

programme.title: Fish Hunt Northwest
programme.sub-title: Ocean Trifecta On Board The Gambler
programme.desc: The FHN Crew jumps aboard The Gambler with buddy Captain Jed Stout in pursuit of the Ocean Trifecta, Tuna, Bottomfish and Salmon; can they get it done all in one trip?

programme.title: Wiebe Trapline Adventures
programme.sub-title: Maine Fisher/Marten with Ken, Bob, Butch
programme.desc: In the quiet, deep woods of northern Maine, three aging trappers chase marten and fisher. Ken, Bob and Butch enjoy the camaraderie, the wilderness and a bountiful catch as they trek through the incredible, scenic timber of the Maine backcountry.

programme.title: Country Raised
programme.desc: Blaine and Junior head to the heart of Texas looking for whitetails in the brush country. Meanwhile, Jeff pursues bucks in the Midwest's prime farmland habitat. Three hunters, two regions, one shared passion for chasing the perfect whitetail buck.

programme.title: Live The Wild Life
programme.sub-title: Father and Son: Adventures From New Zealand to Alaska
programme.desc: Host Gus looks back on some of his most memorable hunts through the eyes of his son Chris, who served as his cameraman across multiple world-class adventures.

programme.title: Mass Pursuit Tv
programme.desc: Keith heads to Gopher Ridge in West Virginia with a monster in his sights.

programme.title: Walk In Tubs
programme.desc: Walk in Tubs - Affordable bath remodel.

programme.title: Deertopia
programme.desc: Steve Bartylla debunks the doe factory myth, explaining how over-improving land can drive mature bucks out of their bedding areas. Learn how to strategically segregate your property, create low-impact travel dead zones and more.

programme.title: Road Trip Angler
programme.desc: Jameson Redding hits the road to find the best fishing spots in America.

programme.title: Take Aim Adventures
programme.desc: We follow along as Rob takes his grandson Rory out for the youth hunt. They have a super fun time and realize they had a shooter in front of them the whole time! Gabe takes out his son Danny and the biggest buck on the property happens to show up.

programme.title: Wallhanger Tv
programme.desc: Chris Wall and Family head west chasing big country memories as Missy's hunt delivers an unforgettable payoff.

programme.title: Doug Koenig's Championship Season
programme.desc: Join Shooting Pro Doug Koenig as he travels with his son Bradley to Hallsville, MO at the Green Valley Rifle and Pistol Club to compete in Day 1 of the 2026 CMP Bianchi Cup Championship. Doug is shooting for his 21st Bianchi Cup win. Part 1 of 2.

programme.title: Jimmy Houston Outdoors
programme.desc: Fishing in Tampa Bay with Capt Ryan Reynolds.

programme.title: Hank Parker's Outdoor Magazine
programme.desc: Wally Marshall is Hanks guest today. They head to Florida where you'll easily see why he is known as Mr. Crappie.

programme.title: North American Trapper
programme.desc: Head to the wide-open country of South Dakota as we pursue coyotes with snares. Follow proven snaring techniques, from reading coyote sign and selecting the right locations to setting and checking snares in the field.

programme.title: Fly Rod Chronicles

programme.title: Midwest Outdoors
programme.desc: Roger Cormier is throwing jerkbaits for fall walleyes on Rainy Lake; and Troy Peterson is looking for bluegills during a tough bite on Big Green.

programme.title: Fisherman's Digest
programme.desc: John Bergsma showcases fishing hot spots in the Great Lakes region.

programme.title: Akc Good Dog Tv

programme.title: Cuando los tiburones atacan
programme.desc: Durante 2019, las playas de Carolina del Norte se vieron sacudidas por cuatro ataques de tiburón en menos de dos meses. Desesperados por restaurar la armonía en este paraíso vacacional, los expertos buscan pistas que puedan revelar la causa.

programme.title: Cuando los tiburones atacan
programme.desc: En tan solo diez minutos, cuatro nadadores se convierten en víctimas de tiburones en Myrtle Beach, Carolina del Sur. Un equipo de investigadores intentan develar la verdad detrás de los misteriosos ataques.

programme.title: Cuando los tiburones atacan
programme.desc: En diciembre de 2010, una manada de tiburones convirtió el paraíso tropical de Sharm el-Sheij, Egipto, en una zona de caza para depredadores. En menos de una semana, se produjeron cinco ataques, uno de ellos mortal.

programme.title: Cuando los tiburones atacan
programme.desc: Florida es la capital mundial de los ataques de tiburones. Más personas son mordidas a lo largo de un pequeño tramo de la costa de Florida, cerca de New Smyrna Beach, que en cualquier otro lugar del planeta.

programme.title: Cuando los tiburones atacan
programme.desc: Entre 2013 y 2015, las playas tropicales de la gran isla de Hawái fueron el lugar de nueve ataques brutales de tiburón, que dejaron a los pobladores y turistas perplejos.

programme.title: Cuando los tiburones atacan
programme.desc: Tres personas en las playas de las Bahamas sufren ataques de tiburón. Los expertos intentan descubrir por qué se produjeron los ataques.

programme.title: Hombre vs. tiburón
programme.desc: Después de inventar trajes blindados para buzos hace 40 años, Jeremiah Sullivan salta al agua para probar cuán resistente es su última creación contra los hambrientos tiburones martillo y los mortales tiburones tigre.

programme.title: Tiburón vs. atún
programme.desc: Un choque entre dos gigantes oceánicos en las costas de la remota isla de Ascensión. Los atunes son más grandes, rápidos y fuertes que los tiburones, pero los escualos tienen un instinto asesino sin parangón en el reino animal.

programme.title: Tiburones caníbales

programme.title: Yukon Vet

programme.title: Cuando los tiburones atacan
